data.text:
IN PHOTOS: A fire hit Sitio Silangan, Barangay Tejero, Cebu City on May 16, displacing 247 families (945 individuals). It destroyed 120 houses and partially damaged 14, affecting a total of 134 homes. Among those impacted were 71 sharers, 40 renters, and 11 lodgers. Evacuees are temporarily sheltered at the Tejero Elementary School Gym.

📸: Alan Tangcawan
